purpose: Teach: 小平/小樽/明石/近江/杉並/伏見/新庄/川越

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、小平に研究所を建てられた
lines.en: When you were young, Dad, you helped establish that research lab in Kodaira.
lines.style: Gentle, reminiscent opening. Warm curiosity, not interrogation. Pace unhurried. Slight lift at the end — inviting him into shared memory rather than testing knowledge.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは北海道小樽の支店設立に尽力された
lines.en: Yes. My father devoted himself to setting up the Otaru branch in Hokkaido.
lines.style: Steady, respectful pace. Quiet pride threaded through. Each location named with care and weight. Voice settles with each syllable — this is history he carries.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、明石の工場創設に立ち会われた
lines.en: And you were there when he founded that factory in Akashi.
lines.style: Soft, almost wondering tone. Like turning a page in a book he knows by heart. Slight pause before the location — letting the memory surface. Trailing gently at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは近江商人の経営理念を学ばれた
lines.en: Yes. My father learned the business philosophy of the Ōmi merchants.
lines.style: Measured, contemplative. Voice deepens slightly on the principle — there is weight in what was learned. Not rushed. A man passing down what matters.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、東京杉並にお住まいだった
lines.en: You lived in Suginami, Tokyo, when you were young.
lines.style: Quiet, almost dreaming tone. As if seeing the young man he knew in that old address. Gentle pace. Slight trailing off — a moment held, not forced.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは京都伏見の酒蔵と取引された
lines.en: Yes. My father did business with sake breweries in Fushimi, Kyoto.
lines.style: Calm, grounded delivery. Each place-name given full presence. Voice carries both respect and a kind of quiet satisfaction — these were real partnerships, real places.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、山形県新庄市と縁を持たれた
lines.en: And you had ties to Shinjo in Yamagata Prefecture.
lines.style: Softer still. Almost whispering the question. This is intimate memory now — connection to a place, not just business. Slow pace. Voice trails like mist.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは埼玉県川越の歴史的街並みを愛された
lines.en: Yes. My father cherished the historic character of the streets in Kawagoe, Saitama.
lines.style: Warm closing. Word 'cherished' lands with genuine affection. Unhurried, almost gentle. This last memory held like something precious. Voice settles with quiet completion.
